notes.title: Guns and Spurs 2 Delay Announcement
notes.content:
I wanted to announce that Guns and Spurs 2 will be delayed on PC because I will need additional time to work on the game.
I was initially aiming for the release in April but unfortunately I need more development time to make sure that everything works as expected and also to polish the game as much as possible.

Thank you for your continued support, patience and understanding.

Please stay tuned for more updates.
